---
id: deploy-runbook
title: Deploying the demo service
kind: runbook
tags: [deploy, ci]
updated: 2026-09-10
scope: project
---

The demo service runs behind a single reverse proxy. Everything below assumes
you are on the build host and the working tree is clean.

## Before you start

Check that the test suite is green and that nobody else is mid-release. A
release that races another one leaves the proxy pointing at a build that was
never tagged.

## Deploy

```sh
# comments in here start with ## and must NOT split the section
## pick the tag first
make release TAG=v1.2.3
```

The build writes a manifest next to the artefact.

## Rollback

Point the proxy back at the previous manifest and restart it. No database
migration is ever undone automatically; see [[sqlite-over-vectors]] for why the
index is a throwaway.

title: Карта машины
kind: map
tags: [machine, map]
updated: 2026-09-08
scope: global
---

Что где стоит на рабочей машине: диски, сервисы и куда уезжают резервные копии.

## Диски

Системный диск один, внешний подключается по USB. Бэкапы уезжают на внешний
диск каждую ночь, и раз в неделю проверяется, что архив читается.

## Сервисы

Прокси и демон очереди стартуют через launchd. Логи лежат рядом с конфигами,
ротация раз в сутки.

---
id: sqlite-over-vectors
title: Why this index is SQLite FTS5 and not a vector store
kind: decision
tags: [search, sqlite]
updated: 2026-09-11
---

The corpus is a few dozen small documents that one person writes by hand.

## The decision

Full-text search over the sections beats embeddings here: there is no scale to
amortise an embedding pipeline over, and an exact word is what the author
actually looks for.

## What it costs

No synonym or morphology matching. A query has to use a word the document uses,
which is a real limitation and an acceptable one at this size.

documents.text:
---
id: tmux-cheatsheet
title: tmux keys worth remembering
kind: cheatsheet
tags: [tmux, cli]
updated: 2026-09-09
scope: global
---

A short list, kept short on purpose. A rollback of a bad pane layout is
`prefix + :kill-session`, which is why that word shows up here too.

## Panes

`prefix + %` splits vertically, `prefix + "` horizontally, `prefix + z` zooms
one pane to the whole window.

## Sessions

`tmux ls` lists them, `tmux attach -t name` joins one, `prefix + d` detaches
without stopping anything that runs inside.

description: Why cache entries expire after a day.
tags: [cache]
generated:
  by: platform-team
  at: 2026-09-12T10:00:00+02:00
stale_after: 2026-10-01T00:00:00+02:00

Entries expire after one day.

## Decision

Short lifetimes keep the cache honest. A failover to the standby node empties it anyway.

## Retention

Backups are kept for a week, see [the nightly backup](./backup-runbook.md).

indexMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
  doc_id  text not null references docs(id) on delete cascade,
  heading text not null,           -- '' is the preamble before the first '## '
  ord     integer not null,
  body    text not null,
  primary key (doc_id, ord)
)

indexMaster.name: chunks_fts
indexMaster.sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunks_fts using fts5(
  doc_id unindexed,
  heading,
  body,
  tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
)

indexMaster.name: chunks_fts_config
indexMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

indexMaster.name: chunks_fts_content
indexMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2)

indexMaster.name: chunks_fts_data
indexMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

indexMaster.name: chunks_fts_docsize
indexMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

indexMaster.name: chunks_fts_idx
indexMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

indexMaster.name: docs
indexMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE docs (
  id      text primary key,
  path    text not null,
  title   text not null,
  type    text not null,           -- as written (legacy 'kind' is capitalised)
  type_key text not null,          -- the type lowercased in JS: the filter compares this, SQLite's lower() folds ASCII only
  description text not null,       -- '' when the document has none
  tags    text not null,           -- a JSON array, queried with json_each
  status  text not null,           -- draft | stable | deprecated
  stale_after  text,               -- ISO 8601 with offset; staleness is computed on read, never stored
  generated_at text,               -- ISO 8601 with offset; null when the document has no 'generated'
  mtime   integer not null,        -- ms, the file's mtime at index time
  hash    text not null            -- sha256 of the file, first 32 hex chars
)

indexMaster.name: meta
indexMaster.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (key text primary key, value text not null)

usageMaster.name: usage_by_doc
usageMaster.sql: CREATE INDEX usage_by_doc on usage_events(doc_id, ts)

usageMaster.name: usage_events
usageMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE usage_events (
  ts      integer not null,             -- ms since the epoch
  doc_id  text    not null,
  heading text    not null default '',  -- '' for a whole document or a search hit
  kind    text    not null,             -- 'get' | 'hit'
  caller  text                          -- the MCP client or $TA_LABEL; null when nobody said
)

files.name: deploy-runbook.md
files.text:
---
id: deploy-runbook
title: Deploying the demo service
kind: runbook
tags: [deploy, ci]
updated: 2026-09-10
scope: project
---

The demo service runs behind a single reverse proxy. Everything below assumes
you are on the build host and the working tree is clean.

## Before you start

Check that the test suite is green and that nobody else is mid-release. A
release that races another one leaves the proxy pointing at a build that was
never tagged.

## Deploy

```sh
# comments in here start with ## and must NOT split the section
## pick the tag first
make release TAG=v1.2.3
```

The build writes a manifest next to the artefact.

## Rollback

Point the proxy back at the previous manifest and restart it. No database
migration is ever undone automatically; see [[sqlite-over-vectors]] for why the
index is a throwaway.

files.name: mashina-karta.md
files.text:
---
id: mashina-karta
title: Карта машины
kind: map
tags: [machine, map]
updated: 2026-09-08
scope: global
---

Что где стоит на рабочей машине: диски, сервисы и куда уезжают резервные копии.

## Диски

Системный диск один, внешний подключается по USB. Бэкапы уезжают на внешний
диск каждую ночь, и раз в неделю проверяется, что архив читается.

## Сервисы

Прокси и демон очереди стартуют через launchd. Логи лежат рядом с конфигами,
ротация раз в сутки.

files.name: relizy-zametki.md
files.text:
---
id: relizy-zametki
title: Заметки по релизам
kind: note
tags: [release, deploy]
updated: 2026-09-07
---

Короткие заметки о том, что ломалось в прошлые релизы. Порядок шагов — в
[[deploy-runbook#Deploy]].

## Что ломалось

Дважды забывали снять флаг обслуживания. Один раз прокси остался на старом
манифесте, и это заметили только по графику ошибок.

files.name: sqlite-over-vectors.md
files.text:
---
id: sqlite-over-vectors
title: Why this index is SQLite FTS5 and not a vector store
kind: decision
tags: [search, sqlite]
updated: 2026-09-11
---

The corpus is a few dozen small documents that one person writes by hand.

## The decision

Full-text search over the sections beats embeddings here: there is no scale to
amortise an embedding pipeline over, and an exact word is what the author
actually looks for.

## What it costs

No synonym or morphology matching. A query has to use a word the document uses,
which is a real limitation and an acceptable one at this size.

files.name: tmux-cheatsheet.md
files.text:
---
id: tmux-cheatsheet
title: tmux keys worth remembering
kind: cheatsheet
tags: [tmux, cli]
updated: 2026-09-09
scope: global
---

A short list, kept short on purpose. A rollback of a bad pane layout is
`prefix + :kill-session`, which is why that word shows up here too.

## Panes

`prefix + %` splits vertically, `prefix + "` horizontally, `prefix + z` zooms
one pane to the whole window.

## Sessions

`tmux ls` lists them, `tmux attach -t name` joins one, `prefix + d` detaches
without stopping anything that runs inside.

## The decision

Full-text search over the sections beats embeddings here: there is no scale to
amortise an embedding pipeline over, and an exact word is what the author
actually looks for.

type: Runbook
title: Nightly backup run
description: How the nightly backup runs and how to restore it.
tags: [backup, ops]
generated:

sources:

    title: Backup tool manual
status: stable
---

The nightly job copies the data volume to a second disk.

## Run

Start it by hand with `make backup`. The retention rules live in [the cache policy](/cache-policy.md#retention).

```sh
# links in code are not links: [[no-such-doc]] and [gone](/no-such-doc.md)
make backup
```

## Restore

Restore the newest copy first. The reasoning is in [[cache-policy#Retention]].

---
type: Decision
title: Cache policy
description: Why cache entries expire after a day.
tags: [cache]
generated:
  by: platform-team
  at: 2026-09-12T10:00:00+02:00
stale_after: 2026-10-01T00:00:00+02:00
---

Entries expire after one day.

## Decision

Short lifetimes keep the cache honest. A failover to the standby node empties it anyway.

## Retention

Backups are kept for a week, see [the nightly backup](./backup-runbook.md).
